name: WorkUnitId
definition: Stable logical identity of one declared unit of executable work across attempts.
equality_semantics: Exact namespace, identifier and birth edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Never reused within its authority scope.

name: JobId
definition: Identity of a finite collection of work units governed as one runtime job.
equality_semantics: Exact authority, namespace, identifier and generation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: A retry of a job may preserve JobId only when the job contract says so.

name: AttemptId
definition: Unique identity of one physical try to execute a work unit.
equality_semantics: Exact identifier; attempt ordinal is descriptive and insufficient alone.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Every retry creates a new AttemptId.
An AttemptId has exactly one terminal outcome.

name: ActorId
definition: Logical actor identity scoped to an actor system and incarnation policy.
equality_semantics: System ID, logical ID and incarnation where restart semantics require it.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Incarnation change is observable when mailbox or state continuity is not preserved.

name: WorkerId
definition: Identity of a concrete runtime worker occurrence.
equality_semantics: Executor scope, worker identifier and boot epoch.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Restart creates a new boot epoch.

name: ExecutorId
definition: Identity of a runtime component that assigns tasks to workers or slots.
equality_semantics: Authority, identifier and generation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Executor identity is independent of host identity.

name: ProcessIdentity
definition: Process identity robust to operating-system PID reuse.
equality_semantics: Boot identity, PID and process start identity.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: PID alone never establishes equality across time.

name: ThreadIdentity
definition: Thread identity scoped to a process incarnation.
equality_semantics: ProcessIdentity plus runtime thread identity and birth generation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Thread ID reuse does not preserve identity.

name: AsyncTaskId
definition: Identity of a cooperatively scheduled asynchronous task.
equality_semantics: Runtime scope and task identity.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: A task may migrate between worker threads without identity change.

name: ResourceId
definition: Stable identity of a logical or physical allocatable resource.
equality_semantics: Owning authority, resource class, immutable identifier and incarnation where relevant.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Mutable hostname or provider display name is not sufficient.

name: ProviderResourceId
definition: Provider-scoped identity of a provisioned or provisionable resource occurrence.
equality_semantics: Provider authority, account/project scope, provider resource identifier and incarnation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Provider reuse must change incarnation or be detected by lifecycle evidence.

name: DeploymentOccurrenceId
definition: Identity of one realized deployment occurrence of a compiled runtime plan.
equality_semantics: Release ID, target ID and occurrence identifier.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Redeployment after destructive replacement creates a new occurrence.

name: ResourceClassId
definition: Identity of a semantic resource dimension such as CPU time, exclusive GPU device or network bandwidth.
equality_semantics: Exact registry ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Class identity includes units and sharing semantics.

name: ResourceQuantity
definition: Exact amount in one resource class and canonical unit.
equality_semantics: Dimension, rational magnitude, canonical unit and qualifier set.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Magnitude is finite and non-negative unless a delta type is explicitly used.
Binary and decimal byte units never collapse.

name: ResourceVector
definition: Finite map from resource class to exact quantity.
equality_semantics: Canonical ordered map after unit normalization.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: No duplicate dimensions.
Unknown dimensions are retained as typed gaps.

name: ResourceDemand
definition: Workload-owned minimum, target and maximum resource vectors with hard/soft topology constraints.
equality_semantics: Demand identity and edition; structural equality is not identity.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: minimum <= target <= maximum under dimension partial order.
Blocking dimensions are finite.

name: ResourceOffer
definition: Time-bounded promise of allocatable resource capacity and qualities backed by evidence.
equality_semantics: Offer ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Offer names capacity, validity, interruptibility, topology and evidence freshness.
Offer does not imply allocation.

name: ResourcePoolId
definition: Identity of a governed set of resource offers with a reconciled capacity ledger.
equality_semantics: Authority, pool ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Membership changes increment pool edition.

name: Quota
definition: Authority-scoped maximum admitted or consumed quantity over a declared scope and window.
equality_semantics: Quota ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Quota never claims physical availability.
Usage and holds reconcile against limit.

name: FiniteBudget
definition: Consumable bound over money, energy, carbon, attempts, time or another exact dimension.
equality_semantics: Budget ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Currency/unit and accounting window are explicit.
Hard effects require precharge or equivalent hold.

name: Precharge
definition: Atomic budget hold acquired before an effectful operation begins.
equality_semantics: Precharge ID.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: At most one terminal commit, refund or expiry.
Committed amount cannot exceed held amount without a new authorization.

name: AdmissionDecision
definition: Accepted, held or refused result of evaluating work against policy, quota, evidence and coarse feasibility.
equality_semantics: Decision ID and immutable content digest.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Includes evaluated policy editions and typed reasons.
Accepted is not scheduled.

name: ResourceReservation
definition: Exclusive or shared capacity hold pending commit or expiry.
equality_semantics: Reservation ID.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Hold has owner, quantity, pool, validity and state.
Expired reservation cannot commit.

name: ResourceAllocation
definition: Committed assignment of resource capacity to a workload or occurrence.
equality_semantics: Allocation ID.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Allocation references committed reservation or atomic allocation proof.
Release is idempotent and append-only evidenced.

name: Lease
definition: Time-limited authority to act on an allocation or coordination role, renewable under declared rules.
equality_semantics: Lease ID and generation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Expiry is determined by lease authority time.
Renewal never decreases fencing token.

name: FencingToken
definition: Monotonically ordered authority token used by protected resources to reject stale actors.
equality_semantics: Exact authority scope and monotonic ordinal.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Protected effects accept only a token newer than the last accepted token.

name: Heartbeat
definition: Time-scoped signal that an identified actor was observable to an authority.
equality_semantics: Issuer, subject, sequence and observation time.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Does not prove useful progress.
Missed heartbeat threshold is policy, not part of the observation.

name: ResourceTopologyGraph
definition: Versioned graph of resource containment, attachment, proximity, sharing and failure relations.
equality_semantics: Graph digest after canonical node and edge ordering.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Each edge names relation kind, validity and evidence.
Containment and failure correlation are separate edges.

name: PlacementConstraint
definition: Hard predicate or soft scored preference over resource/topology candidates.
equality_semantics: Canonical predicate/score expression and owner edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Hardness is explicit.
Soft preference declares weighting and tie-break interaction.

name: PlacementAssignment
definition: Versioned selection of concrete resource candidates for admitted work.
equality_semantics: Assignment ID and immutable content digest.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: References exact demand and inventory editions.
Carries hard-constraint proof and score trace.

name: SchedulerPolicy
definition: Owned objective, eligibility, ordering, selection, tie-break and quality contract for scheduling.
equality_semantics: Policy ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Mechanism and provider are not embedded in policy identity.
Heuristic policies disclose lack of optimality proof.

name: Priority
definition: Ordered urgency class within a declared authority and policy scope.
equality_semantics: Authority, policy edition and ordinal/class.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Priority has no cross-policy ordering without an explicit mapping.

name: PreemptionPolicy
definition: Rules governing eligibility, victim selection, grace, checkpoint and compensation.
equality_semantics: Policy ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Names protected classes and disruption limits.
Preempted outcome remains distinct from failure.

name: Deadline
definition: Absolute instant by which a scoped phase is expected to complete.
equality_semantics: Time scale, instant, uncertainty and scope.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Time scale and clock authority are explicit.

name: CancellationRequest
definition: Idempotent request that identified execution stop under a declared mode and deadline.
equality_semantics: Request ID.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Acknowledgement and terminal stop are separate facts.
Request names graceful, checkpoint, interrupt or force mode.

name: BackpressureSignal
definition: Downstream capacity or demand signal constraining upstream emission.
equality_semantics: Channel scope, sequence and demand/credit value.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Credit never becomes negative.
Overflow policy is separately declared.

name: CheckpointRef
definition: Content-addressed checkpoint plus compatibility and lineage metadata.
equality_semantics: Digest, schema, artifact and runtime compatibility tuple.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Checkpoint bytes without compatibility metadata are not resumable proof.

name: FailureDomain
definition: Set or relation of resources exposed to a correlated fault assumption.
equality_semantics: Authority, domain ID, failure-mode edition and membership edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Failure mode and correlation assumption are explicit.

name: ResourcePressureObservation
definition: Measured time in which work was delayed due to CPU, memory or I/O contention.
equality_semantics: Subject, interval, metric edition and value.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Pressure is not inferred from utilization alone.

name: ResourceHealthState
definition: Time-scoped assessed availability/degradation state of a resource.
equality_semantics: Subject, assessor, observation time and assessment generation.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Includes evidence and expiry/recheck trigger.

name: CostRate
definition: Monetary amount per exact pricing unit and validity interval.
equality_semantics: Currency, rational amount, pricing unit, provider/authority and validity.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: List, contracted, effective and billed rate kinds are distinct.

name: ResourceUsageReceipt
definition: Signed or attributable observation of consumed or allocated quantity over an interval.
equality_semantics: Receipt digest.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Names measurement method, subject, interval, unit, uncertainty and issuer.
Never overwrites prior corrected observations.

name: PowerEnvelope
definition: Permitted or observed power range for a resource or workload.
equality_semantics: Subject, watts, interval and kind (limit/target/observed).
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Power is a rate and never represented as energy.

name: EnergyReceipt
definition: Attributed energy quantity over a time interval with measurement/model provenance.
equality_semantics: Receipt digest.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Uses joules or canonically convertible energy unit.
Estimated values include model identity and uncertainty.

name: RuntimeSloContract
definition: Population, indicator, objective, window and error-budget contract for runtime behavior.
equality_semantics: SLO ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: No objective without exact SLI and window.
Missing data policy is explicit.

name: TargetProfile
definition: Evidence-backed execution target capabilities, ABIs, mechanisms and constraints.
equality_semantics: Target ID and edition.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Compatibility is proved against artifact and runtime requirements.

name: RuntimeReceipt
definition: Append-only typed evidence of one runtime/control-plane fact linked into a causal chain.
equality_semantics: Canonical content digest and issuer signature scope.
canonical_form: Canonical JSON with explicit edition, unit and scoped identifiers; no float quantities.
invariants: Includes subject, claim, event and recording time, issuer and evidence scope.
